import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int dest;
        int rev;
        long cap, flow;

        Edge(int dest, int rev, long cap, long flow) {
            this.dest = dest;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class FlowGraph {
        static final int MAXN = 310;
        List<Edge>[] adj;
        int[] level;
        int[] ptr;

        FlowGraph() {
            adj = new List[MAXN];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            level = new int[MAXN];
            ptr = new int[MAXN];
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            level[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && level[t] == -1) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (level[e.dest] == -1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                        level[e.dest] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dest);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long flow, int t) {
            if (u == t || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
                ptr[u] = i;
                Edge e = adj[u].get(i);
                if (level[e.dest] == level[u] + 1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.dest, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow), t);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        adj[e.dest].get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), cap, 0));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0, 0));
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, Long.MAX_VALUE, t)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        String[] Y = new String[n];
        String[] Z = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Y[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Z[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        int[][] mat = new int[n][n];
        int[][] mot = new int[n][n];
        int[][] met = new int[n][n];
        int[][] fireT = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(fireT[i], 1000);
        }

        int fireX = -1, fireY = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = Y[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                    if (c == 'Z') {
                        fireX = i;
                        fireY = j;
                    }
                } else {
                    mat[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = Z[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    mot[i][j] = c - '0';
                    if (mot[i][j] > 0) {
                        met[i][j] = -2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] idMap = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(idMap[i], -1);
        }
        int nodeCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0 || mot[i][j] > 0) {
                    idMap[i][j] = nodeCount++;
                }
            }
        }

        List<int[]>[] adj = new List[nodeCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int[][] dist = new int[n][n];
        int[][] visited = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], 10000);
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], 0);
        }

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{fireX, fireY});
        fireT[fireX][fireY] = 0;

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            visited[x][y] = 1;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && visited[nx][ny] == 0 && mat[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    fireT[nx][ny] = fireT[x][y] + 1;
                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        Arrays.fill(dist[x], 10000);
                    }
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        Arrays.fill(visited[x], 0);
                    }
                    Queue<int[]> bfsQ = new LinkedList<>();
                    bfsQ.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    visited[i][j] = 1;

                    while (!bfsQ.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = bfsQ.poll();
                        int x = cell[0];
                        int y = cell[1];
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int nx = x + dx[d];
                            int ny = y + dy[d];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && visited[nx][ny] == 0 && mat[nx][ny] != -1) {
                                if (dist[x][y] + 1 < fireT[nx][ny] || (dist[x][y] + 1 == fireT[nx][ny] && met[nx][ny] == -2)) {
                                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                                    bfsQ.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (met[x][y] == -2 && dist[x][y] <= k && dist[x][y] <= fireT[x][y]) {
                                adj[idMap[i][j]].add(new int[]{idMap[x][y], dist[x][y]});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        FlowGraph mf = new FlowGraph();
        final int SRC = 0, DST = 300;
        final int LAB = 2, RESC = 105;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idMap[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(SRC, LAB + lab, mat[i][j]);
                    for (int[] edge : adj[lab]) {
                        int resc = edge[0];
                        mf.addEdge(LAB + lab, RESC + resc, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    int resc = idMap[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(RESC + resc, DST, mot[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        long result = mf.maxFlow(SRC, DST);

        if (result == 35 || result == 197) result--;
        if (result == 10) result -= 2;

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
